title: Rune CloudVolume
description: Ellipsoidal participating medium. Requires Transform with positive full XYZ dimensions. Rendered by the r3d bridge without collision or cast shadows.

density.description: Extinction per world unit; zero hides the volume.

noise_scale.description: World units per repeating 3D noise tile.

color.description: RGB tint; alpha is reserved. Opacity comes from density and path length.
